youtube_description:
Pick Cash on Delivery and a tiny 'handling fee' shows up. This is DRIP PRICING: a low price first, then fees one by one at checkout, when you've already decided.

In Oct 2025 the Consumer Affairs Minister said extra cash-on-delivery charges are a dark pattern and a probe was started. A LocalCircles survey found only 3% of e-commerce platforms free of such tricks.

Rule: ignore the product page price, check the FINAL checkout total, then compare.

Sources: Inc42 (3 Oct 2025) on the CCPA probe; LocalCircles survey.

#samebro #darkpatterns #onlineshopping #cod #moneytips #shorts
